product_family: Revenue AI OS - AI-powered conversation intelligence platform with sub-products: Gong Engage (sales engagement), Gong Forecast (pipeline forecasting), Gong Enable (sales enablement), Gong Agents (agentic automation), Gong Revenue Graph (data connectivity), and Gong Collective (integrations/services).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR Compliance with Standard Contractual Clauses for EEA, UK, and Swiss transfers; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certified

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: CSA STAR and CSA STAR Level 1

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework
certifications.proof_quote: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF), UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF, and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

privacy.ai_training_note: Gong explicitly states 'your data is never used to train generative models.' Training is per-customer only; cross-customer training only occurs on safe cases like transcription, not business-specific processes. ISO 42001 certified with dedicated AI governance team focused on ethical use and human validation.
privacy.data_region: New customers can choose US or EU data centers. Parent company headquartered in Israel; data processing offices in US, Israel, and Ireland. Complies with DPF, UK GDPR, and Swiss data protection frameworks.

security.name: Key management
security.value: AWS Key Management Services with bring-your-own-key (BYOK) option

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-based access control with four standard roles plus granular permission profiles; workspace segmentation for least privilege

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Single Sign-On support for Google, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and other major identity providers

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logging accessible via Gong Audit API in JSON format; tracks both user activity and Gong personnel access to customer data

security.name: Monitoring and threat detection
security.value: Real-time monitoring and threat detection with built-in redundancy

security.name: Backup and disaster recovery
security.value: Regular daily backups for disaster recovery

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Independent penetration testing conducted regularly with executive summaries available through Trust Center

security.name: Data redaction
security.value: Custom redaction capabilities for sensitive sequences; enables regulated industries to safely leverage AI insights

products.name: Gong Engage
products.data_scope: Processes email, call recordings, transcripts, and communications data. Analyzes customer interactions for insights.
products.notes: Prioritizes and personalizes sales engagement; uses AI agents for targeted communications

products.name: Gong Forecast
products.data_scope: Processes pipeline, deal, and forecast data; analyses conversation insights for forecasting accuracy
products.notes: Provides unbiased insights and centralized analytics for org-wide action

products.name: Gong Enable
products.data_scope: Processes customer call recordings, transcripts, and interaction data to create training content
products.notes: AI Trainer feature allows teams to practice using simulated conversations from real customer interactions within Gong environment

products.name: Gong Agents
products.data_scope: Processes pipeline, CRM, and interaction data for automated actions
products.notes: Automates follow-ups, pipeline edits, enablement triggers, and forecast corrections

products.name: Gong Revenue Graph
products.data_scope: Central data store capturing interactions across email, calls, CRM, and integrations
products.notes: Automatically captures and connects every interaction across customer's business

products.name: Gong Collective
products.data_scope: Curated third-party integrations and professional services
products.notes: Robust ecosystem of integrations and expert services

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS; usage-based or per-user tiers available; custom enterprise pricing
compare.data_residency: Cloud-hosted on AWS; new customers can choose US or EU data centers
